Skills.Name: Voyage
Skills.Description: You can gain navigating Experience to upgrade Navigation Skill Level by sailing in High Sea or storm Scene, exploring Findings and by accomplishing Tasks of Adventurer Alliance. A higher Navigation Skill Level allows more available Skills and Ship Types.
Skills.Info: It can increase the Sailing Speed during voyage, and at the same time increase usable Ship Types.

Skills.Name: Bare-handed Fighting
Skills.Description: You can gain Bare-hand Experience thus to upgrade Bare-hand Skill Level by fighting either with an arm or bare-handedly, thus affecting the character's Maneuver Rate and HP Max.
Skills.Info: It can increase the Hit Rate in Bare-hand Attacks; Be sure to learn the relevant battling Skills and use them more effectively.

Skills.Name: Timber-felling
Skills.Description: Timber Felling in the Suburb can increase the Timber-felling Experience and Timber-felling Level. Timber Felling Skill affects the Type of wood logged and the Success Ratio of Timber-felling. High-Level Timber can only be logged with the relevant Level Timber-felling Skill.
Skills.Info: It can increase the success ratio of Timber-felling and the Types of Timbers that you can fell.

Lesson.Offer: The Timber-felling skill will allow you to gather logs and refine them into timber.  Timber is highly sought after for ship improvements and repairs.  I charge my students 5000 silver coins to learn this skill.  Would you like to learn?

Skills.Name: Sea Battle
Skills.Description: Sea Battle Experience will be increased and the Sea Battle Level will be upgraded by applying Cannon attack, Ramming Attack and Grappling in Sea Battle or by completing the Tasks of Ares Warrior Alliance. The Sea Battle Skill can affect the Available Battle Skills in Sea Battles.

Skills.Name: Medicine
Skills.Description: After learning this Skill, you can gain Medical Study Experience thus to upgrade Medical Skill Level by using Potion. The Level affects the effect of the Potion. It can even relieve Unconscious  and Poisoned State and will affect SP Max of the character.
Skills.Info: It can increase the effectiveness of your Potion. They can relieve unconsciousness and prevent further poisoning.

Lesson.Offer: The Healing skill improves the effect of healing potions and increases your maximum SP limit.  I charge 10,000 silver to teach the skill.  Would you like to learn?
Lesson.Refusal: I only teach medicine to those who have a need for it.  Advance one of your battle skills to Level 3, and I will teach you Healing then.

Skills.Name: Mining
Skills.Description: Mining in the Suburb can increase the mining Experience and mining Level. Mining Skill affects the Type of Ore mined and the Success Ratio of mining. High-Level Ore can only be mined with the relevant Level mining Skill.
Skills.Info: It can increase the success ratio of Mining and the Types of Ores that you can mine.

Lesson.Offer: The Mining skill will allow you to extract ores and refine metals.  Metals are highly sought after for ship improvements and weapons manufacture.  I charge my students 5000 silver coins to teach the skill.  Would you like to learn?

Skills.Name: Eloquence
Skills.Description: In every Port, trading will earn profits. After accomplishing Tasks of Merchant Guild, Eloquence Experience will be awarded and the Speech Skill Level will be upgraded. Eloquence affects the bargaining amount during trading and the Level of Goods purchased during vending.
Skills.Info: After learning it, you can buy in at a low price and sell out at higher price during trading and increase profits and reduce expenditure.

Skills.Name: Falchion-playing
Skills.Description: You can gain Falchion Experience thus to upgrade Falchion Skill Level by fighting with Falchion. Falchion Skill affects the Hit Rate and Attack Power during Weapon attack and the Types of Weapon that can be used. Defense will increase when Falchion is equipped.20%
Skills.Info: It can increase the Hit Rate and usable Falchion Types during Falchion Attack; make sure you learn more relevant battling Skills and use them more effectively.

Lesson.Offer: The Falchion-playing skill allows you to use various types of falchions.  The higher level of the skill, the more powerful weapons you can use. I can teach you this art for 7000 silver coins.  Would you like to learn?

Skills.Name: Planting
Skills.Description: Planting in the Suburb can increase the Planting Experience and Planting Level. Planting Skill affects the Type of Crops planted and the Success Ratio of planting. High-Level Crops can only be planted with the relevant Planting Skill Level.
Skills.Info: It can increase the success ratio as well as the yield of Planting and make sure you can cultivate more Types of Plants.

Lesson.Offer: The Planting skill will allow you to grow and harvest crops.  The fruits and leaves that you harvest can be refined into potions or processed into clothes and sails.  The fee for learning the Planting skill is only 5000 silver coins.  Would you like to learn this skill?

Skills.Name: Sword-playing
Skills.Description: You can gain Sword Experience thus to upgrade Sword Skill Level by fighting with Sword. Sword Skill can affect the Hit Rate and Attack Power and the Types of Weapon that can be used.
Skills.Info: It can increase your Hit Rate and usable Sword Types during Sword Attacks; make sure you learn more relevant battling Skills and use them more effectively.

Lesson.Offer: After you learn the basics of Sword-playing, you can wield all types of swords.  The higher your level, the more deadly your choice of weapons.  Learning swordplay costs 7000 silver coins.  Would you like to learn?

Skills.Name: Ship-building
Skills.Description: Affects the Type of Ship Models built and the Success Ratio of Ship Building. The higher the Skill is, the more Types of Ship Models can be made and their Level will be higher.

Lesson.Offer: The Shipbuilding skill allows you to make various types of ship models and repair ships.  I can teach you the art for 8000 silver coins.  Would you like to learn?

Skills.Name: Shooting
Skills.Description: You can gain Gun Experience thus to upgrade Gun Skill Level by fighting with Gun. Gun Skill affects the Hit Rate and Attack Power and the Types of Weapon that can be used. Defense will decrease when Gun is equipped.70%
Skills.Info: It can increase your Hitting Rate and usable Gun Types while shortening the Loading Time; make sure you learn more relevant battling Skills and use them more effectively.

Lesson.Offer: If you want to pack a firearm, you must learn the Shooting skill.  The higher your skill, the more deadly and accurate the weapons you may wield.  I charge 10,000 silver coins to teach this skill.  Would you like to learn?

Skills.Name: Foundry
Skills.Description: Affects the Type of Weapons and Armors forged and the Success Ratio Forging. The higher the Skill is, the more Types of Weapons and Armor can be forged and the their Level will be higher.
Skills.Info: It can increase the success ratio of Producing and the Types of Article you can produce.

Lesson.Offer: The Forging skill will allow you to create new weapons and tools from refined metals.  I teach Forging for 5000 silver coins, and I only teach to experienced miners (Mining skill level 5 or higher).  Would you like to learn this skill?
Lesson.Refusal: I teach Forging only to those who have proven their worth as experienced miners (Mining skill level 5 or higher).  Please return when you have met this requirement.

Skills.Name: Axe-playing
Skills.Description: You can gain Axe Experience thus to upgrade Axe Skill Level by fighting with Axe. Axe Skill affects the Hit Rate and Attack Power and the Types of Weapon that can be used. Defense will decrease when Axe is equipped.20%
Skills.Info: It can increase the Hit Rate and usable Axe Types during Axe Attack; make sure you learn more relevant battling Skills and use them more effectively.

Lesson.Offer: Axe-playing is not for trees; it's for heads.   The higher your skill at Axe-playing, the more deadly the weapons at your disposal.  I can teach you the basics for 7000 silver coins.  Would you like to learn?

Skills.Name: Alchemy
Skills.Description: affects the Type of Potion refined and the Success Ratio of Alchemy. High-Level Potion can only be refined with correspondent Alchemy Skill Level.
Skills.Info: It can increase the success ratio of Mixing Potions and the Types of Potions you can mix.

Lesson.Offer: Alchemy will allow you to refine various potions from herbs.  I can teach this arcane art to experienced farmers (Planting skill level 3 or higher) for 1200 silver coins.  Do you care to learn this skill?
Lesson.Refusal: Those who would learn the secrets of Alchemy must first experience the lore of herbology.  Please return when you have achieved Planting skill level 3.

Skills.Name: Sewing
Skills.Description: Will influence the Success Ratio of Tailoring and the Types of Clothes that can be tailored. The higher the Skill is, the more types of clothing will be available and the Clothing Level will be  higher.
Skills.Info: It can increase the success ratio of Clothes Making and the Types of Clothing you can make.

Lesson.Offer: You can make and mend clothes and sail after learning the sewing skill.  I only teach it to those who can harvest raw materials (Planting skill level 5 or more).  I charge 18,000 silver coins to teach sewing.  Would you like to learn?
Lesson.Refusal: Learning sewing skill requires Planting skill of Level 5.  Please return after you have improved your skill.

Skills.Name: Fishing
Skills.Description: Fishing in the Offshore can increase the fishing Experience and fishing Level. Fishing Skill affects the Type of fish caught and the Success Ratio of fishing. High-Level fishes can only be caught with the relevant Level fishing Skill.

Lesson.Offer: If you learn Fishing, you can reap the bounty of the sea.  The fish you catch can be sold to the stores, and some are quite valuable.  The fee for learning fishing is 5000 silver coins.  Would you like to learn this skill?
